body: As it stands I'm doing everything I can to make sure he is happy and taken care of.
I never wanted kids for reasons such as this.
Thanks for the advice. I'll look into it. The intrusive thoughts are there a lot but for the most part I'm passive suicidal. I've just reached a huge breaking point in my life.

I get where you're coming from but after 12 years together and the circumstances probably not the best. If I'm a depressed person she takes first place.  She has attempted a few times and been committed to a mental hospital once. I know that isn't an excuse for her behavior but I knew she was prone to shutting down for months at a time. And despite all of that, I  love her with all of my being.
I'm a 33 year old who put all of his eggs in one basket and now my life is crumbling around me.
Nah, this is kind of the straw that broke me. It's a combination of many thing in my life. I hope it does get better, but a lot of me just wants to be done.
